created_prompt: Julie posts cooking videos of quick, healthy recipes and currently has 1.2 million followers. She wants to publish a cookbook but isn't sure if she should go through traditional publishing or self-publishing. She works 4 days a week, so she has limited time and limited budget. Make a concrete 3 year plan for Julie to grow her online presence and publish a cookbook. Go step by step and take into account the prior factors. Weigh the pros and cons of traditional versus self-publishing for her cookbook.
